requirements.title: Inline Image Magic Byte Detection in read_file
requirements.rationale: Directly inspecting image header bytes avoids third-party image decoding dependencies while cleanly rejecting binary image formats.

criteria.action: prevent imports of `github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/imagex`, `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/imagex`, and `golang.org/x/image`
criteria.contract: `tools/tools.go` does not import `imagex` or `golang.org/x/image`; the `read_file` Description contains no reference to image outputs; the `read_file` OutputSchema does not declare image result properties

setup: the tools package AST and read_file tool declaration
check.pseudocode:
f = parseAST("tools/tools.go")
for imp in f.Imports:
    assert imp.Path != "github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/imagex"
    assert imp.Path != "github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/imagex"
    assert imp.Path != "golang.org/x/image"
tool = readFileTool()
assert !contains(tool.Description, "image")
schemaBytes = json.Marshal(tool.OutputSchema)
assert !contains(schemaBytes, "mime_type")
assert !contains(schemaBytes, "width")
assert !contains(schemaBytes, "height")

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match PNG magic bytes
criteria.action: return an error result identifying the PNG format
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK set to false, Error set to unsupported_file, and Detail stating that reading images is not supported and naming PNG

setup: a workspace containing files with PNG and JPEG magic bytes
check.pseudocode:
writeFile("sample.png", []byte{0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A, 0x00})
resPNG = readFile(ctx, {"path": "sample.png"})
assert resPNG.OK == false
assert resPNG.Error == "unsupported_file"
assert contains(resPNG.Detail, "reading images is not supported")
assert contains(resPNG.Detail, "PNG")

writeFile("sample.jpg", []byte{0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF, 0xE0, 0x00, 0x10, 0x4A, 0x46, 0x49, 0x46})
resJPEG = readFile(ctx, {"path": "sample.jpg"})
assert resJPEG.OK == false
assert resJPEG.Error == "unsupported_file"
assert contains(resJPEG.Detail, "reading images is not supported")
assert contains(resJPEG.Detail, "JPEG")

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match JPEG magic bytes
criteria.action: return an error result identifying the JPEG format
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK set to false, Error set to unsupported_file, and Detail stating that reading images is not supported and naming JPEG

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match GIF magic bytes

requirements.title: Agent Scaffolding Decoupling
requirements.rationale: Agent execution must function without session persistence, compaction tokens, middleware wrappers, or audit and tracing hooks.

criteria.action: remove struct fields and methods referencing `session.Recorder` or `middleware.Chain` from `agent.go`
criteria.contract: `Agent` struct has no fields referencing `session.Recorder` or `middleware.Chain`; `Agent` has no `CacheStats`, `Meter`, or `Continue` methods; `loop.go` contains no calls to `compaction.EstimateContextTokens`

setup: the Agent struct definition and loop methods in agent.go and loop.go
check.pseudocode:
agentType := reflect.TypeOf(agentkit.Agent{})
for i := 0; i < agentType.NumField(); i++ {
    f := agentType.Field(i)
    assert f.Name != "rec"
    assert f.Name != "meter"
    assert !strings.Contains(f.Type.String(), "session.Recorder")
    assert !strings.Contains(f.Type.String(), "middleware.Chain")
}
_, hasContinue := agentType.MethodByName("Continue")
assert !hasContinue
_, hasCacheStats := agentType.MethodByName("CacheStats")
assert !hasCacheStats
loopSrc := readFile("loop.go")
assert !strings.Contains(loopSrc, "compaction.EstimateContextTokens")

execution_paths.title: Agent executes read_file on an image file and receives format-specific rejection

steps.action: initiates an agent tool execution calling `read_file` with the path to a PNG image file
reads leading magic bytes from the target file without invoking external image decoders
detects PNG header bytes and constructs a structured error result
receives the error result indicating unsupported file format naming PNG

setup: a workspace containing a binary image file (sample.png) starting with PNG magic bytes
end_state: `read_file` returns core.ToolResult with OK false and Error 'unsupported_file'
the error detail explicitly states reading images is not supported and names PNG
no external image decoding library is invoked
smoke.pseudocode:
ws := tools.NewWorkspace(t.TempDir())
os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(ws.Root, "test.png"), []byte{0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A, 0x00}, 0644)
allTools, _ := tools.All(tools.Options{Workspace: ws})
var readFileTool core.Tool
for _, t := range allTools {
    if t.Name == "read_file" { readFileTool = t; break }
}
res := readFileTool.Execute(context.Background(), json.RawMessage(`{"path":"test.png"}`))
assert !res.OK
assert res.Error == "unsupported_file"
assert strings.Contains(res.Detail, "reading images is not supported")
assert strings.Contains(res.Detail, "PNG")
